title: GE Vernova Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At June 30, 2026, cash and restricted cash were USD 13.120 billion, long-term borrowings were USD 2.794 billion, and 266.334 million shares were outstanding; Q2 diluted weighted-average shares were 270 million.
summary: The Q2 filing supplies balance-sheet, diluted-share, backlog-quality, working-capital, acquisition and Wind-risk inputs needed to normalize the issuer release and construct a bounded valuation sensitivity.
